title: Departure Fulfilment & Group Leader
outcome: Approved operator members can see the package a departure is fulfilling and record one accompanying group leader as governed departure operational metadata without changing traveller readiness or commercial commitments.
actor: Approved operator members preparing and handing over a departure.
modules: Catalogue remains authoritative for the package/departure commercial relationship.
Booking owns the departure operational group-leader assignment and append-oriented audit evidence.
VS-27 remains authoritative for traveller readiness; the group leader does not become a traveller or alter readiness counts unless separately booked through the normal booking flow.
VS-28 final handover consumes the same operational record and remains immutable after completion.
routes: Pilgrim manifest -> View package being fulfilled -> existing operator package/departure preview
Pilgrim manifest -> Add or update group leader -> governed departure operational record
Pilgrim manifest -> Final handover -> group leader visible in closeout context
Final handover -> View package being fulfilled -> existing operator package/departure preview
acceptance: Manifest and final handover show the authoritative package name and a reachable View package being fulfilled link without inventing a second package relationship.
An approved operator member can set, update, or clear one accompanying group leader name for an owned departure before final handover completion.
Group leader changes are operator-isolated, version-checked, attributable and append-audited.
A foreign departure identifier returns safe not-found behavior and cannot create or mutate operational metadata.
Completed final handover prevents later group-leader mutation so closeout history remains immutable.
The group leader is operational metadata only: it does not become a booked traveller and does not affect traveller, ready or blocked counts.
Existing payment, document, visa, accommodation, booking and Catalogue source states are not mutated by group-leader operations.
The operator UI provides loading, success, stale/completed error and retry-safe feedback with visible focus and minimum 44px controls.
The fulfilment panel reflows without horizontal overflow at 390px and remains operable by keyboard and touch.
Forward-only Booking migration and model-snapshot parity are present for persistence changes.
Rendered and navigation evidence belongs to the exact unchanged implementation SHA.
exclusions: Making a group leader a NoorPath account, operator member or booked traveller automatically.
Collecting passport, date of birth, gender, phone or other group-leader personal data not required by this approved slice.
Changing traveller readiness derivation, payment, documents, visa, accommodation or handover blocker policy.
Changing package/departure commercial ownership or booked customer commitments.
Airline, hotel, supplier, insurance or WhatsApp integration.
